structure.note: One class of common stock. The 2026 proxy gives Elon Musk 19.8% beneficial ownership and Vanguard Capital Management 5.3%, the only holders above 5%. Musk also holds 423,743,904 unearned restricted shares under the 2025 CEO Performance Award; they are voted proportionately with all other shares under a voting agreement and are left out of his figure.

notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (data.js fy 'Dec 2025'). Financial figures are from the FY2025 Form 10-K (accession 0001628280-26-003952, filed January 29, 2026) and match SEC XBRL. OWNERSHIP is from the 2026 proxy statement (DEF 14A filed October 19, 2026, accession 0001104659-26-116700, for the December 3, 2026 annual meeting), as of September 30, 2026. Musk's 699,580,882 shares are 413,152,109 held by the Elon Musk Revocable Trust plus 286,428,773 restricted shares issued when he exercised the 2018 CEO Performance Award in the quarter ended June 30, 2026 (they carry votes and are subject to a service condition to January 19, 2028); he no longer holds exercisable options. The figure excludes 423,743,904 unearned restricted shares granted under the 2025 CEO Performance Award (approved by shareholders November 6, 2025), which are voted proportionately by Tesla's corporate secretary; the proxy says 'corresponding adjustments have been made to the shares outstanding' for his 19.8%, so his percentage is measured against outstanding shares less those unearned shares. 207,498,721 of his shares are pledged. HOLDERS: only Vanguard Capital Management (5.3%, Schedule 13G filed April 30, 2026) is listed above 5%; the proxy gives the filing date, not the holding date, so asOf is null. BlackRock no longer appears in the table. BUYBACKS: the 2025 cash-flow statement has no share repurchase line, so 0. STOCK COMP: 2,825 million is the cash-flow add-back (XBRL ShareBasedCompensation).

paidout.notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (FY2025 Form 10-K, accession 0001628280-26-003952). The capex line is reported net of sales of property and equipment and excludes finance leases; the FY2025 cash-flow statement has no separate intangible-asset or solar-system purchase lines. Operating-lease vehicles (net 25 million in 2025) are inside operating cash flow (flagged). Taxes paid: after adopting ASU 2023-09 the 10-K moved cash taxes to the income-tax note's by-jurisdiction table ($1,232 million, tagged IncomeTaxesPaidNet).

owners.notes: NBIM: the quote is this company's row in NBIM's holdings data file at June 30, 2026 ("o" = ownership %, "eq.v" = voting %, "a.e" = market value in USD, "a.n" = in NOK). CalPERS: the source is the information table of CalPERS's Form 13F for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Form 13F covers only U.S.-listed securities, and the quoted row gives issuer, class, CUSIP, value in dollars and shares. The CalPERS percentage divides its September 30, 2026 shares by the 10-Q cover count at October 15, 2026, the same count used in the marketcap lens (it includes Musk's unearned 2025 CEO Performance Award shares, which are issued and outstanding).

marketcap.notes: One class of common stock, listed on Nasdaq as TSLA; no preferred stock is outstanding. The 10-Q cover count is used as stated. It includes the 423,743,904 shares of performance-based restricted stock granted to Elon Musk under the 2025 CEO Performance Award, which the 10-Q balance sheet counts among the 3,953 million shares issued and outstanding even though they are unearned and voted proportionately; the 2026 proxy excludes them when computing his ownership percentage.
